import json,hashlib

from ghidra.program.disassemble import Disassembler

from ghidra.program.model.symbol import SourceType
from ghidra.app.decompiler import DecompInterface
from ghidra.app.util.cparser.C import CParser
from ghidra.app.cmd.function import ApplyFunctionSignatureCmd
p=currentProgram;api=FlatProgramAPI(p,monitor);fm=p.getFunctionManager();af=p.getAddressFactory()
root=Path('D:/game/reverse-engineering/tiny-glade/evidence/round12/structure-outline')
rows=json.loads((root/'native-ranges.json').read_text())['functions'];reports=[]
tx=p.startTransaction('bounded original structure outline evidence');ok=False

 for row in rows:

  f=fm.getFunctionAt(a)
  if f is None:f=api.createFunction(a,'structure_outline_'+row['address'])
  body=AddressSet(region)
  for other in fm.getFunctionsOverlapping(body):
   if other.getEntryPoint()!=a:body.delete(other.getBody())
  f.setBody(body)
  if row['address']=='0x140959fc0':
   proto='void structure_outline('+','.join('void *p'+str(i) for i in range(12))+');'
   cmd=ApplyFunctionSignatureCmd(a,CParser().parse(proto),SourceType.USER_DEFINED)
   if not cmd.applyTo(p,monitor):raise ValueError('Prototype failed')
  reports.append({'range':row,'body_bytes':f.getBody().getNumAddresses(),'prototype':str(f.getSignature())})
 ok=True
finally:p.endTransaction(tx,ok)

try:
 for report in reports:

  report['completed']=bool(result.decompileCompleted());report['error']=str(result.getErrorMessage())
  if result.decompileCompleted():
   code=str(result.getDecompiledFunction().getC());(root/(report['range']['address']+'.fresh.c')).write_text(code,encoding='utf-8');report['chars']=len(code)
finally:di.dispose()
(root/'overlay-revision.json').write_text(json.dumps({'worker':'color-menu-full','program_sha':str(p.getExecutableSHA256()),'reports':reports},indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
